Up to the galleries
Four themed floors, four themed rooms
Red rock
One canyon silhouette from the aisle. Up here the floor is the rock itself: terracotta, with a warm seam.
Neon
A dark floor that keeps the light. The sculpture in the hall is the same study, seen from the Queen K.
Sea glass
Pale glass underfoot, the colour of the bay on a still morning.
Obsidian
Basalt, and a line of heat. The same coast as the hall, one storey closer to the weather.
The growth
A Speedmax taken by the room. Vines have the frame, pods sit on the floor, and the walls are the same green as the growth.
The passage
One bulb over a Speedmax at the end of the passage. The corridor is narrower than the room. If the eyes blink, you were looking.
The bay
Four rings over a Speedmax, and a scan that does not care what it passes through. Cold light, no weather.
The yard
They keep to the walls. A Speedmax is still on the block in the middle of the yard. The air is the colour of a bruise that has started to heal.
